title: Simultaneous computation of multiple excited states via double bracket flows
byline: Saem; Reyhaneh Aghaei; Sahebi; Mehrad; Holmes; Zoë; Suzuki; Yudai
html:
Abstract:Efficient computation of excited states is essential for studying strongly correlated many-body systems and molecular electronic structure. In this work, we propose a framework for simultaneously simulating multiple excited states based on dynamical flows. The main idea is to exploit a common double bracket flow that drives different pure initial states toward different target excited states without such prior information. We establish a necessary condition for convergence and a sufficient condition for exponential convergence. We further develop two scheduling strategies: Chebyshev scheduling, which achieves optimal convergence near a fixed point but requires prior spectral information, and adaptive scheduling, which achieves comparable performance in numerical simulations without spectral information. Our results enable new classical and quantum algorithms for excited-state computation without prior preparation of lower-energy eigenstates.
